portable_html_qa.content_mitigation: Wide report tables were removed; all exact case data remains in JSON/CSV. The self-contained report retains semantic chart fallback data.
portable_html_qa.limitation: Installed Windows Chromium engines render the packaged reader, but the shared full-bleed top bar plus a traditional vertical scrollbar creates an 8px document-width overflow (measured clientWidth=1409, scrollWidth=1417). This is a packaging-reader layout issue, not an analytical data overflow.

quantitative_sections_without_additional.difficulty_breakdown: The two difficulty comparisons are stated directly; exact fields remain in summary.json.
quantitative_sections_without_additional.examples: Case-level answer previews and audit hashes require exact lookup and remain in cases.json/cases.csv rather than a wide report table.
quantitative_sections_without_additional.high_frequency_patterns: Patterns overlap, so another partition-like chart would be misleading; definitions and case IDs remain in high-frequency-patterns.json.
